name: clover-charming

purpose.why: Rebuilt on Evan's request (2026-10-22) to replace the Ranch tile's original model with a crafted one, keeping its game role.
purpose.audience: children building and playing in a miniature ranch

brief.prompt: a whimsical storybook version of a low patch of pasture clover with round white and pink flower heads, oversized plump petals and leaves, bouncy rounded toy-like shapes

concept.tool: Midjourney web app (midjourney.com/imagine), driven in Evan's signed-in Chrome by Claude through the Claude in Chrome extension, one job at a time, text prompts only (no image reference)

hero.prompt: a whimsical storybook version of a low patch of pasture clover with round white and pink flower heads, oversized plump petals and leaves, bouncy rounded toy-like shapes, stylized 3D game asset, low-poly diorama style, flat painted colors, soft studio lighting, plain warm cream background, centered, full object visible, no text --ar 1:1
hero.pick_reason: low plump patch of readable trefoil leaves with round pink-white heads, whole patch with margin

construction.by: modeler agent, directed by the art director (Claude)

rounds.change: First charming build: 40 trefoils with round puffed 4-tri leaflets (46-56 mm), 15 big spheroid heads (22-27 mm) on bowed 2-segment stems, nod 0.35, lean 0.06. Camera calibrated to yaw 10 / elev 25.
Straight single-segment stems to free triangles for 45 trefoils, leaves layered higher to hide the core, taller heads (1.3x) with more pink, heads spread wider (0.16 x 0.11 m), 14 heads.
Lean raised to 0.15 (the hero crowds right), lower, rounder mound (0.11 m), heads 24-29 mm, pinker cream. Taller heads (rise up to 0.16 m) and a wider base were tried and dropped (0.65-0.75).
Bigger leaflets (50-60 mm) and a stronger head nod (0.5 rad), kept for charm though nod alone cost 0.002. Final 768 px / 48 samples.

what_was_done: Copied the finished normal clover (build.py, make_views.py, hero_check.py, run.sh) and reshaped it. Same structure: mound of trefoils over a dark core dome, loose trefoils on the rim, heads on stems, a couple of grass blades; the same seven materials and mesh names (Leaf_Green, Leaf_Pale, Leaf_Shade, Leaf_Grass, Stem_Green, Petal_Cream, Petal_Pink), no new ones; origin at the footprint centre on the ground, front -Y, plain GLB (plant: no states).

The hero is the only input (no turnaround for plants). make_views.py keys it against the cream backdrop; the cast shadow falls left and under the front leaves and is a darkened cream/olive (red at or above green), while every leaf is green-dominant, so below row 1380 every pixel with G < 1.02 R is dropped, with a keep box for the lowest head. A 12-step closing above that row fills the heads' near-white highlights that the cream key punched out.
Calibrated over yaw -20..20 / elev 10..30: best at yaw 10-20, elev 25-30. Fixed at yaw 10, elev 25 (the normal used 0/22) and held it.

35 mound + 10 rim trefoils (normal: 44 + 14), each leaflet a 4-triangle fan (normal: 3) with a rounder coin-like outline (half-width 0.78 of length, a rounded 3-point rim), 50-60 mm long (normal 38-48 mm), and its middle puffed up 16 % of its length so it cups and reads plump.

14 big round heads (normal 32 small ones), radius 24-29 mm (about twice the normal), each a 5-sided spheroid 1.3x taller than wide: a cream cap and upper band over a pink drooping skirt (the pink-tipped outer florets). 25 triangles each, open underneath (hidden by the stem and leaves; double-sided material).

Thicker 4 mm stems splay outward (heads sit 55 % further out than the stem base) and each head nods outward up to 0.5 rad, more at the rim. The whole patch leans to +X by 0.15 m per metre of height (about 8.5 deg), the storybook tilt; the hero's heads also crowd right, and the lean raised IoU.
A plump round-shouldered dome (profile (1-r^2)^0.5, 0.11 m) on the same 0.36 x 0.28 m ellipse, leaves layered at 80-105 % of the dome so the top is fully covered.

1,000 triangles (ground plant budget 1k): leaves 540, heads 350, stems 84, core 24, grass 2. Size 0.456 x 0.376 x 0.224 m (normal 0.415 x 0.354 x 0.199): width/depth 1.21 against the normal's 1.17. to_game.py installed it as simulations/regional-assets-charming/UP-051.glb and added it to the charming manifest.
construction.creative_additions: Pink drooping skirt under each head for the pink outer florets; heads nod outward like they are bouncing; the whole patch leans a little, as in the hero.

geometry.up: Z (Blender source); Y in GLB and game
geometry.origin: centre of the footprint, on the ground

good: Hero IoU 0.790 at the final 768 px / 48 samples render from the matched camera.
Reads as the same clover patch at tile size, but toy-like: fewer, bigger, rounder leaves, a crown of big plump pink-and-cream heads nodding outward, and a gentle lean.
Same materials, mesh names, origin and near-identical footprint ratio as the normal model, so it swaps in place.
off: Under the harness lighting the head caps read almost white; the hero's heads are a warmer pink-cream with visible ribbed florets. The pink shows mainly on the skirt underneath.
The hero has about 16 heads, some low in the front leaves; this has 14 (budget), mostly in a crown on top.
The hero's leaves are denser and smaller relative to the heads than 45 trefoils can give within 1k triangles; the front has a few big flat trefoils.
Footprint ratio 1.21 vs the normal 1.17 (the lean adds width at the top).
IoU moves about +/-0.03 with the random seed; kept the normal's seed 23 rather than seed-picking.

rights: Original work for Abbie's World. Concept art generated on Evan's Midjourney account; geometry generated procedurally, no third-party meshes or textures.
